From the owner
Planning a kitchen remodel in Sarasota often feels like a puzzle where the pieces do not seem to fit. You might find yourself stuck between choosing the right layout and worrying about whether your contractor will actually show up on time. This uncertainty often leads to delays or a finished space that does not match what you imagined. At Alpha Kitchen Design, we remove that stress by handling the project management from start to finish. Because we are a family-owned business, you get direct communication with the owner. This means your specific needs for custom cabinets and granite countertops stay at the forefront of every decision. If you are starting your planning process, here are 5 trends currently shaping homes in Sarasota: 1. Mixed Material Countertops. Homeowners are pairing different textures, such as combining matte finishes with polished stone surfaces to create visual interest. 2. Hidden Storage Solutions. Using custom cabinetry to conceal small appliances keeps your workspace clear and organized. 3. Statement Backsplashes. Moving away from plain tile, many local projects now feature oversized slabs or unique patterns that serve as a focal point. 4. Zone-Based Layouts. This involves designing specific areas for prep work, cooking, and cleaning to improve the flow of the room. 5. Integrated Lighting.
